summary: Hepion Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing a September 3, 2026 convertible note purchase agreement with Gravitas Capital LP. The company issued a $500,000 secured convertible note bearing 8% PIK interest maturing September 3, 2027, plus a warrant for 12,500,000 shares. Conversion is at $0.04 per share and warrant exercise at $0.06 per share, both exercisable only after stockholder approval of an authorized-share increase. The note is secured by all company assets. This is a routine financing, not a special situation, though the potential 12.5 million-share overhang and required stockholder vote warrant monitoring.
